channel.title: Rugspull Evidence Updates

item.title: Office Counter report 014 — 2026-07-19
item.description: Search Console accepted the 47-URL sitemap and reports 47 discovered pages. The new no-double-rug guide is not indexed because Google cannot recognize the URL and has no referring sitemap; a priority indexing request was initiated. IndexNow accepted 58 URLs. Discovery and request activity do not prove indexing, ranking, clicks, approval, audit, adoption, or endorsement.

item.title: What does no double rug mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to the Creator-only, post-unlock, full Founder Allocation sale; Active-to-Rugged lifecycle consumption; atomic rollback; invariant retry scope; and why one-shot does not mean no rug risk.

item.title: What does no double claim mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to aggregate wallet entitlements, mutually exclusive successful and Failed claim paths, checks-effects-interactions, atomic rollback, Creator stake separation, invariant scope, and the difference between one-shot and fully settled.

item.title: What does WBNB conservation mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to WBNB movement through Factory fees, Creator stake, contributions, Failed and excess refunds, pool reserves, swap fee splits, the Founder sale, rounding residue, and invariant scope.

item.title: What does token conservation mean?
item.description: A Builder guide to RugToken's one-time fixed supply, formula-based launch allocation, Opening claims, canonical swaps, the full Founder sale, holder accounting, and the limits of conservation evidence.

item.title: What are smart contract invariants?
item.description: A Builder guide to Rugspull's 12-action Foundry state machine, seven conservation and lifecycle properties, 128-run by 64-depth configuration, and the limits of project-authored invariant evidence.

item.title: What are alternative pools on BNB Chain?
item.description: A venue-separation guide to canonical RugPool identity, external pools, independent reserves and prices, routing, approvals, LP controls, aggregators, and cross-market execution risk.

item.title: Why is Cloudflare D1 not financial truth?
item.description: A Builder guide separating D1 discovery and event-derived market caches from authoritative contract state, receipts, balances, action gating, and wallet-signed settlement.

item.title: Why does verified source code not mean audited?
item.description: A review guide separating bytecode/source correspondence from independent security assessment, including compiler settings, deployment configuration, multi-contract scope, project-authored tests, and the evidence required for a real audit claim.

item.title: What does MEV mean for a BNB Chain AMM swap?
item.description: A risk-first guide to transaction ordering, stale reserve quotes, minimum output, deadlines, atomic reverts, fees, the full Founder sale, and separate alternative pools. These controls do not guarantee inclusion, fair sequencing, price, liquidity, an exit, or safety.
